scope.closed_scope_rule: T6 and 750x/760x artifacts were not changed or used to test this preflight.

module.design: SyntheticNoopBinder uses ordinary embedding lookup, previous-token concatenation, frozen key network, frozen LayerNorm, frozen four-query bank, and frozen W_v; only appended noop_embedding requires grad.
module.start_handling: First-token previous state is an ordinary zero prefix, matching GenericNRoleBinder.forward; no BOS token is invented.
module.vocabulary_extension: Existing IDs remain [0,old_vocab_size); OP_NOOP is appended at old_vocab_size.

coverage: catalog cardinality, [4,34] matrix, and loss orientation
real backward to e_N and sigmoid derivative
bit-exact old route and append-only IDs
ordinary lookup/scorer with no NOOP shortcut or no_grad path
four NONE targets distinct from zero vectors and VALUE_0

catalog_and_loss.score_position_rule: Only the OP_NOOP position is selected; LINK->OP_NOOP does not become a complete instruction and START->LINK is not added.
catalog_and_loss.orientation: score-b; positive derivative pressure lowers NOOP score relative to fixed NULL threshold
catalog_and_loss.start_forward: START means zero previous embedding in the ordinary forward, not a new BOS token.

measured_backward.normalization: Because loss is a mean over 136 terms, autograd dL/ds=sigmoid(s-b)/136; the unnormalized per-term derivative is sigmoid(s-b).
measured_backward.evidence_kind: real torch backward measured on connected graph; no hand-written pass flag

freezing.graph_rule: No torch.no_grad() is used in score/noop_candidate_scores; gradient reaches e_N while frozen tensors remain constants.
freezing.threshold_rule: b_r is a fixed buffer/parameter with requires_grad=false and is not optimized.

previous_route_preservation.test: Change e_N by +17.0 under torch.no_grad and rescore three old-token instructions.
previous_route_preservation.interpretation: Appending e_N cannot alter lookup or scores for instructions whose IDs contain no OP_NOOP.

inference_without_shortcuts.source_test: inspect.getsource(SyntheticNoopBinder.score) contains self.lookup(token_ids) and self.key_network, but no noop_token_id, OP_NOOP, active_roles, return-zero shortcut, or no_grad.
inference_without_shortcuts.output_contract: Four existing query scores; downstream role result remains argument or NONE.

null_contract.canonicalization: Canonicalize only after a role is predicted present; token presence alone does not imply a value.

t6_training.verified: T6 batch accepts only four roles; behavior uses FLOOR/AVOID; reference uses four role targets; calibration uses atomic+40 BG; no NOOP path.

t3_noop.verified: T3 has atomic NOOP rows with no numeric value target; noop_details is computed but disconnected from encoder state targets, reference/separation exclude NOOP, and L_sep records noop_excluded=true.

generic_forward.verified: Actual key path is local_norm(local_binding(concat(previous,embeddings))); source has no explicit SiLU in forward.

unified_api.verified: Unified module is API/contract layer and explicitly leaves training orchestration to a later change; its opcode list has no OP_NOOP.

implementation_boundary.implemented_now: Isolated synthetic forward, 34-context catalog, 4x34 loss matrix, exact mean softplus loss, real backward, freezing, old-route preservation, ordinary-path and NULL-contract tests.
implementation_boundary.future_gate: Before real campaign, explicitly decide how NOOP/NONE supervision is integrated; this preflight proves wiring on a synthetic fixture, not scientific transfer or distractor robustness.

discrepancy_record.action: No SiLU was added; hashed source and closed artifacts remain unchanged.

provenance.t7_design_status: Accepted design route T7-NOOP-NONE-LEXICAL; this is supervision preflight only.
